name: Felipe Fernandes
title: Supply Chain Manager
subject: Boluda Towage - Vendor Qualification & Offshore Marine Support / Perenco
email_body:
Dear Felipe Fernandes,

I hope you are doing well,

I am reaching out as the International Commercial Manager at Boluda Towage. We follow Perenco's offshore operations in West Africa closely, particularly on Ogooué mature fields, Campagne raccordement Etame/Tchatamba.

Boluda Towage is the world's leading tug and AHTS operator. We wish to register on your supplier portal and introduce our marine support services.

Could you please guide us on your vendor qualification process and outline any upcoming AHTS or terminal support needs?

Best regards,

Wael FACHATE
International Commercial Manager
wael.fachate@boluda.fr
linkedin_note: Hi Felipe, I'm Wael from Boluda Towage. I'd like to connect to see how our fleet of AHTS/tugs can support Perenco's offshore campaigns in West Africa. Best regards!
